Devon (People Ops): Heads-up: Today's handbook patch — Parental & Caregiver Leave section — is live in the docs. Short summary + action items below.
Elaine (Manager, Core Infra): thanks — is this a mandatory ack for everyone?
Devon (People Ops): Short answer: yes for all full-time employees. Contractors see the note at the bottom. We need team-level manager confirmations for people on LOA.
Carol (Legal): Confirmed. The changes reflect UK statutory updates + our expanded caregiver policy. Legal-reviewed and approved 2026-03-18.
Sara (People Ops): Link to doc: https://docs.redwood.com/handbook/leave/par-caregiver-v2
Sara (People Ops): Tracker (please update by Fri 2026-04-01): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDEFGhI_policy_ack_tracker
Mike J.: quick Q: if someone is on parental leave now, do managers mark them as acknowledged or leave blank?
Devon (People Ops): Managers should mark 'on-leave' in the tracker and e-mail peopleops@redwood.ai so we can follow up after return. See tracker tab "Manager actions".
Elaine (Manager, Core Infra): got it. Can we get a CSV export of the ack list for exec reporting?
Onboarding Bot: Automated reminder scheduled: will ping channels with non-acks on Mon 2026-03-29 09:00 PT
Devon (People Ops): For exports, run this command in the People Ops admin console:
```
po-admin export-ack --policy parental-caregiver --format csv --since 2026-03-18 > parental-ack.csv
```
Carol (Legal): Also note: EMEA variant requires a separate checkbox for 'statutory leave guidance received' — managers in EMEA, please ensure that column is filled.
Mike J.: acked. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Manager, Core Infra): I'll push into my weekly 1:1 slots and nudge folks. Thanks.
Sara (People Ops): Training micro-sessions next week (EMEA friendly slot 16:00 GMT, US slot 10:00 PT). RSVP here: https://cal.com/redwood/handbook-update
Devon (People Ops): If you have any edge-case (international contract terms, pending LOA transitions), DM me or drop in #people-ops. We'll capture exceptions in the tracker.
Mike J.: noted — will coordinate with payroll for a couple of folks.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: please complete the quick ack button in the doc (top-right) or update the tracker. Remaining unacknowledged count will be posted on Mon.
Devon (People Ops): Thanks everyone — appreciate quick turn here so we stay compliant. :heart:
